req.title: Return 404 on unknown post
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when GET/POST /<id>/update or /<id>/delete references a non-existent post id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 404 error when attempting to update or delete a non-existent post. This behavior needs to be verified through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The tests ensure that the system correctly identifies non-existent posts and responds with the appropriate HTTP status code.

tests.name: test_update_non_existent_post
preconditions: The database is initialized and empty.
actions: Attempt to update a post with an ID that does not exist.
expected: The response status code should be 404.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'New Title', 'body': 'New Body'})
assert r.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_post
preconditions: The database is initialized and empty.
actions: Attempt to delete a post with an ID that does not exist.

tests.name: test_update_existing_post
preconditions: The database is initialized with a post having ID 1.
actions: Attempt to update a post with an existing ID.
expected: The response status code should be 200.
The post should be updated with the new title and body.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import get_db
    db = get_db()
    db.execute('INSERT INTO post (id, title, body) VALUES (1, "Old Title", "Old Body")')
    db.commit()

r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'New Title', 'body': 'New Body'})
assert r.status_code == 200

with app.app_context():
    post = get_db().execute('SELECT * FROM post WHERE id = 1').fetchone()
    assert post['title'] == 'New Title'
    assert post['body'] == 'New Body'
